name: Repository Attachment and Detachment
description: Implement the attachment and detachment lifecycle for repositories within a workspace. Attach by path or URL; detach cleanly without data loss. Support multiple repositories per workspace simultaneously. Track attachment metadata including remote URL, local path, branch, and attachment timestamp.
purpose: Users need to add repositories to a workspace as logical units. A clean attach/detach lifecycle ensures repositories can be managed independently — added when needed, removed when done — without corrupting workspace state or leaving orphaned references.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository can be attached by local filesystem path
Repository can be attached by remote URL (clone on attach)
Multiple repositories can be attached to a single workspace simultaneously
Detachment removes repository from workspace state without deleting files (unless explicitly requested)
Detachment cleans up all workspace-internal references to the repository
Re-attachment of a previously detached repository restores metadata
Attachment metadata is persisted and survives workspace restart
Attaching the same repository twice is idempotent — updates metadata, does not duplicate
